title: Post the Writ
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Post the Writ and the helm marks Warrant House. Do: Close on Warrant House. The bailiff patrol reads a hold that lingers in the seized yard. Bailiff Holt names the next tow to Gyre. Finish: come inside Warrant House's shell. The Compact writes standing. Seized hulls still leave for the Swallow. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
